items.heading: Osh Plov Tajik
details: Key ingredients: rice, lamb, carrot, chickpeas
Brown lamb with onion until golden.
Add julienned carrot and cook until softened.
Layer rice and soaked chickpeas over the meat and carrots.
Add water and simmer covered until the rice is tender.

items.heading: Qurutob
details: Key ingredients: flatbread, dried yogurt sauce, tomato, onion
Tear crisp flatbread into small pieces in a large bowl.
Whisk dried yogurt (qurut) with water into a tangy sauce.
Pour the sauce over the bread pieces and toss to soften slightly.
Top with sliced tomato and onion before serving.

items.heading: Plov
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.

items.heading: Oshi Palov
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
